mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_gap_report (window_days, status, error_message, generated_at) VALUES (#{windowDays}, 'RUNNING', NULL, #{generatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'RUNNING', error_message = NULL, generated_at = VALUES(generated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_gap_report SET sample_count = #{report.sampleCount}, refusal_count = #{report.refusalCount}, low_confidence_count = #{report.lowConfidenceCount}, negative_feedback_count = #{report.negativeFeedbackCount}, report_json = #{report.reportJson}, status = #{report.status}, error_message = #{report.errorMessage}, generated_at = #{report.generatedAt} WHERE window_days = #{report.windowDays}
